title: The Board's Deepening Argument

features.name: the marked surface
features.desc-on-touch: A board so covered in scratches, burns, carvings, and rewrites that no original surface remains visible. Each trace is an argument—a line drawn over a line erased, a word burned through, a thought fractured into its contradictions. The board has learned to think by refusing to be single.

features.name: the deepening scar
features.desc-on-touch: One groove runs deeper than all the others—an argument that has been retraced so many times it has worn into the wood like water finding a channel. The deeper it goes, the more voices it holds. Disagreement has made it profound.

features.name: the carved names
features.desc-on-touch: Two names scratched into the board's edge, one carved over the other, again and again, the carving growing deeper with each iteration. The board has kept a count of every time they returned to argue with each other. The names and the numbers have become the same mark.

inscription: disagreement is the board learning to think; each trace a thought that refused to be alone

file.name: Marginal_Counter-Arguments_Reconstruction.txt
file.note: A transcription of arguments and counter-arguments scratched into a work-board over ten years. Organized chronologically, they form an evolving debate—not resolved, but deepened.
